title: Lānaʻi Kōele project district zoning and conditions
summary: On October 21, Chair Lee voiced support for the project and its changes, and the Planning Department said it supports the zoning change and amendment. The landowner asked the Council to put a time limit on the reporting required by condition 8, and a member said they will look to the chair for a reasonable limit. The landowner said the State Land Use Commission approved its district boundary amendment with six votes, its traffic study does not require the bypass road, and homes already built have no income limits.
